title: Past Time Expressions
objectives: Use past time expressions accurately in A2 contexts.
Understand form, meaning, and typical usage.
Produce short spoken and written examples.
canDo: I can use time expressions with the past simple naturally.

warmUp.title: Activate prior knowledge
warmUp.prompt: Before this lesson, recall what you know about past time expressions. How is it similar or different from Portuguese?
reflectionQuestions: When do native speakers use past time expressions?
Can you think of one example?

explanation:
Last + period: last month, last year | … ago: three years ago | In + past year: in 2019 | On + past day: on Monday (finished)

No present perfect yet — focus on finished time.

grammar.title: Past Time Expressions
grammar.rule: Last + period: last month, last year | … ago: three years ago | In + past year: in 2019 | On + past day: on Monday (finished)

reading.title: Past Time Expressions in Context
reading.text: In 2019 I lived in Lisbon. Last year I moved to Porto. Three months ago I changed jobs. At first it was difficult, but then I adapted.

writing.prompt: Write a short paragraph (5–7 sentences) using past time expressions. Use at least 3 words from the vocabulary list.
rubricHints: Use the target structure at least twice.
writing.modelAnswer: I started gym last month. They moved last year. In 2020 we stayed home. I met him once.

tutorHints: Correct gently and ask the learner to reformulate.
Use English for meta-language when possible at A2.
